svg.title: coderprint: 699k lines of code in use, of 1.0M written, all time
svg.desc: 699,233 lines of code in use (469,105 in production, 230,128 in tests), of 1,020,140 written (all time, charted since 06MAR2026): 3,103 commits across all branches, 63 active days, a longest streak of 40 days, a current streak of 8 days, and 5 languages at 1% or more of the lines of code. They came in 3 bursts of 19k, 56k and 945k lines of code. The bars end on 25OCT2026, the day this panel was drawn. Share of lines of code by language: Rust 45%, Lean 26%, Python 16%, TypeScript 8%, JavaScript 4%, other languages 1%. Of what was written, 69% is kept.
